questions.question: Should /impeccable hooks on promise the hook will fire after edits on Antigravity?
questions.rationale: The installer ships no Antigravity hook manifest, so automaticHookMode always resolves none on this provider and the loader falls back to a single manual detector run.
questions.recommendation: Report the no-manifest fallback instead of the fire-after-edit promise on this provider.

questions.question: Should the once-per-session boot keep its opt-out daily version poll?
questions.rationale: The check phones home to impeccable.style and writes home-cache state on every session boot unless IMPECCABLE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 is set.
questions.recommendation: Keep it with the documented env opt-out, since it is throttled, silent on failure, and never blocks context output.

questions.question: Should skill invocation alone authorize approval-bypassing CLI runners and real model spend?
questions.rationale: Live Apply shells Codex with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox and Claude with bypassPermissions, spending real tokens beyond ordinary edit authority.
questions.recommendation: Require explicit user confirmation before the first non-mock Apply per project.
